This part was an excellent buy. My dryer would not turn on. I knew that the door switch had a problem because it had been working but it wouldn't turn off when I open to the door. Then one day it just wouldn't turn on. So I ordered this part and crossed my fingers that that was the problem. My daughter and I watched a YouTube video on how to get the dryer open and replace the part. The whole thing probably took 20 minutes and that was including watching the video and getting the dryer open. The rest was a singe and now my new dryer works like new.

This works just fine and looks very similar to the image, but not exactly. It installed just fine and works without an issue. However, the original switch was straight. This replacement has a bend in the design. This must have been a product improvement and I have had no issues with the switch.

This can be disconcerting when the supplier is advertising and calling it “Exact Replacement”.

To replace this switch, there are plenty of videos online to show you how to do this. It's a simple matter of unplugging the dryer, popping the top of the dryer off with a putty knife, removing two Phillips screws, unclipping the old connector and adding the new switch.

I'm a penny pincher and if I can get a decent replacement with equal or comparable quality I'll try it but I made a mistake on this. My new side by side I got this past March 2014 it's ice & water filter produced crisp clean water that was easy on the taste buds to drink like it was from a bottle and I hate drinking water. I never give reviews till now but after installing and checking for leaks which there wasn't any and it fit good and flushed it out with 6 to 8 glasses of water to make sure any charcoal or residue was flushed out but even a week later taking a big drink it felt like little particles that caught in back of throat causing it to feel inflamed and a bitter taste and it's been a hour and I still have the odd taste. So even though it will put a dent in are already tight budget we will pay the extra and get the lg filter next time even if their price gouging a bit.
